name: Jellyfin
author: barticekk@barticekk.eu
description:
Jellyfin is a free media server for movies, shows, music and photos with apps for TVs, phones and
browsers. Uses the official portable Linux build and jellyfin-ffmpeg. Transcoding runs on the CPU.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Jellyfin install script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -eo pipefail
trap 'echo "Install failed at line ${LINENO}: ${BASH_COMMAND}"' ERR

apt-get update
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl ca-certificates xz-utils libfontconfig1 fonts-dejavu-core

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64) ARCH=amd64; FFMPEG_ARCH=linux64 ;;
    aarch64) ARCH=arm64; FFMPEG_ARCH=linuxarm64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

REPO=https://repo.jellyfin.org/files
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${JELLYFIN_VERSION}" ] || [ "${JELLYFIN_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    SERVER_DIR=${REPO}/server/linux/latest-stable/${ARCH}
else
    SERVER_DIR=${REPO}/server/linux/stable/v${JELLYFIN_VERSION}/${ARCH}
fi
SERVER_FILE=$(curl -fsSL "${SERVER_DIR}/" | grep -oE "jellyfin_[0-9][0-9.]*-${ARCH}\.tar\.xz" | sort -uV | tail -n1)
if [ -z "${SERVER_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "No Jellyfin build found in ${SERVER_DIR}/"
    exit 1
fi
echo "Downloading ${SERVER_FILE}"
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/jellyfin.tar.xz "${SERVER_DIR}/${SERVER_FILE}"
rm -rf jellyfin
tar -xJf /tmp/jellyfin.tar.xz
rm -f /tmp/jellyfin.tar.xz

# newest jellyfin-ffmpeg major that has a portable build for this architecture
for MAJOR in $(curl -fsSL "${REPO}/ffmpeg/linux/" | grep -oE 'latest-[0-9]+\.x' | sort -uV -r); do
    FFMPEG_DIR=${REPO}/ffmpeg/linux/${MAJOR}/${ARCH}
    FFMPEG_FILE=$(curl -fsSL "${FFMPEG_DIR}/" | grep -oE "jellyfin-ffmpeg_[0-9][^\"]*_portable_${FFMPEG_ARCH}-gpl\.tar\.xz" | sort -uV | tail -n1 || true)
    [ -n "${FFMPEG_FILE}" ] && break
done
if [ -z "${FFMPEG_FILE}" ]; then
    echo "No portable jellyfin-ffmpeg build found"
    exit 1
fi
echo "Downloading ${FFMPEG_FILE}"
rm -rf ffmpeg
mkdir -p ffmpeg
curl -fsSL "${FFMPEG_DIR}/${FFMPEG_FILE}" | tar -xJ -C ffmpeg

# SkiaSharp (image processing) needs fontconfig, which the runtime image does not have
LIBDIR=/usr/lib/$(uname -m)-linux-gnu
mkdir -p lib/fonts
for lib in libfontconfig.so.1 libfreetype.so.6 libpng16.so.16; do
    cp -L "${LIBDIR}/${lib}" lib/
done
cp -L /usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/*.ttf lib/fonts/
cat > lib/fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd">
<fontconfig>
    <dir>/home/container/lib/fonts</dir>
    <dir>/home/container/fonts</dir>
    <cachedir>/home/container/cache/fontconfig</cachedir>
</fontconfig>
EOF

mkdir -p data config cache log media fonts
if [ ! -f config/network.xml ]; then
    cat > config/network.xml <<EOF
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<NetworkConfiguration xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <InternalHttpPort>${SERVER_PORT}</InternalHttpPort>
  <PublicHttpPort>${SERVER_PORT}</PublicHttpPort>
  <EnableHttps>false</EnableHttps>
  <EnableIPv6>false</EnableIPv6>
  <AutoDiscovery>false</AutoDiscovery>
  <EnableUPnP>false</EnableUPnP>
</NetworkConfiguration>
EOF
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installed ${SERVER_FILE} with ${FFMPEG_FILE}"
echo "Put media into /home/container/media"
echo "-----------------------------------------"
